title: Bravo award for leading an internship, a year into my career
summary: My manager gave me IBM's Bravo award for leading an internship project end to end within my first year.
what_would_have_happened: The internship would have needed a senior engineer to lead it.
the_call: Take full ownership of the interns and the outcome.
what_i_did: Led the internship project on a visual composition editor for composite services from start to finish.
what_changed: IBM Bravo award citing my ability to lead complex activities end to end early in my career.
